actions.action_goal: {"id": "would_you_rather_{topic_id}", "description": "Ask the group to choose between two options and discuss their choices.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} asks: Would you rather {option_a} or {option_b}?", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "At least one participant shares their choice.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "{robot_name} continues facilitating the discussion for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c4", "description": "{robot_name} summarizes the key points from the discussion.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "Stay neutral - don't judge opinions.", "Create friendly debate between different choices."]}

discussion_time.description: How long to continue the discussion (e.g., '2 minutes', '90 seconds')
